events.title: Energy Fuels' Uranium Revenues Surge 112% in Q126: More Upside Ahead?
events.body: UUUU posts Q1 2026 revenues of $35.8M, up 112% YoY, driven by uranium sales and higher average realized price.

events.title: Cameco Posts Q1 Earning Beat: A Compelling Reason to Buy the Stock?
events.body: CCJ beat Q1 estimates as uranium sales and EBITDA surged, but lower 2026 revenue guidance and a premium valuation may temper upside.

events.title: MP Dips 5% Despite Q1 Earnings Beat: How to Play the Stock?
events.body: MP Materials beats Q1 estimates with record NdPr output and sales, but rising costs, weak momentum and premium valuation pressured shares.

events.title: Should You Buy, Hold or Sell UUUU Stock Post Q1 Earnings?
events.body: Energy Fuels jumps after Q1 revenues more than doubled on uranium sales, even as the company posted a slightly wider-than-expected loss.
